title: brassica nigra var. torulosa
intro: Brassica nigra var. torulosa, commonly known as black mustard, is a plant species within the Brassica genus. The seeds of this plant have been traditionally used in folk medicine for their health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of black mustard seeds include pain relief, digestive aid, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as allyl isothiocyanate, which has been shown to exhibit anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of black mustard seeds include volatile oils, alkaloids, and glycosides, contributing to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
